name: Felt Notes solved preflop spots
format: strategy[class][action] = frequency; ev[class][action] = bb won relative to the start of the hand; class index = row * 13 + col on the 13x13 grid (row/col 0 = ace, suited above the diagonal)

cash-limp1-BB.note: Model: UTG limps an assumed loose-passive range; players behind fold to an iso-raise; after an overlimp or complete the BB checks and the 3-way pot is valued with a realisation model.

gates.gate: fixed point: under 5% of hero's hands move in the last round
pairs: aggressive EV never drops more than 0.1bb with a bigger pair

acceptance.check: fixed point settled (<= 5% of hands moved)
every flop solve < 1% of pot exploitable
strategy is a best response to its own EVs
dominated hands are never worth more

cash-limp1-CO.note: Model: UTG limps an assumed loose-passive range; players behind fold to an iso-raise; after an overlimp or complete the BB checks and the 3-way pot is valued with a realisation model.

gates.gate: fixed point: under 5% of hero's hands move in the last round
pairs: aggressive EV never drops more than 0.1bb with a bigger pair
no seat left to act behind the hero (model folds them)
CO plays tighter than BTN vs a limper (players behind)
CO iso range no wider than BTN

acceptance.check: fixed point settled (<= 5% of hands moved)
every flop solve < 1% of pot exploitable
strategy is a best response to its own EVs
dominated hands are never worth more
weak offsuit hands fold to a limper
CO plays tighter than BTN vs a limper
